name: watchdog_status
desc: 内核看门狗与系统健康状态
cmd: cat /sys/class/watchdog/watchdog0/identity 2>/dev/null; cat /sys/class/watchdog/watchdog0/state 2>/dev/null; echo '--- oops/warn ---'; cat /sys/kernel/oops_count 2>/dev/null; cat /sys/kernel/warn_count 2>/dev/null; echo '--- kp_freeze ---'; cat /sys/kernel/kp_freeze_detect/* 2>/dev/null | head -10
